description: This file contains Redux action creators for fetching and updating general configuration and status in a Mattermost application, including client config, license info, error logging, server version, URL, and CWS availability.

methods.name: getClientConfig
methods.description: Fetches client configuration from the server, updates Client4 settings, and dispatches relevant actions.

methods.name: getLicenseConfig
methods.description: Retrieves license configuration using a bound client function.

methods.name: getCustomProfileAttributeFields
methods.description: Fetches custom profile attribute fields via a bound client function.

methods.name: logClientError
methods.description: Logs a client error with specified message and log level.

methods.name: setServerVersion
methods.description: Sets the server version in state and loads roles if needed.

methods.name: setUrl
methods.description: Sets the URL for the Client4 API.

methods.name: setFirstAdminVisitMarketplaceStatus
methods.description: Marks the first admin visit to the marketplace as completed.

methods.name: getFirstAdminSetupComplete
methods.description: Retrieves and dispatches the completion status of the first admin setup.

methods.name: checkCWSAvailability
methods.description: Checks the availability of CWS if the enterprise build is enabled.
